**Hiring Team**  
Tabcorp / MAX  
Sydney, New South Wales, Australia  

**Re: Senior Test Engineer**

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the **Senior Test Engineer** position at Tabcorp (MAX). With over 19 years of quality engineering experience delivering manual and automated test strategies across complex enterprise systems, payments platforms, and distributed technology, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to the reliability and quality of MAX’s gaming venue technologies.

My background directly aligns with the technical and coordination requirements outlined for this role:

* **Automated & Manual Testing Expertise:** At Wpay (Woolworths Group), I engineered full end-to-end automation suites using **Playwright** alongside native mobile frameworks, while managing automated API regression suites within CI/CD pipelines. My technical skillset includes working knowledge of Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and C#.
* **Test Strategy & Lifecycle Management:** I have extensive hands-on experience driving integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Utilizing tools such as **Jira**, **Zephyr**, and TestRail, I consistently maintain robust test traceability, document comprehensive test scenarios, and enforce quality gates.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination & Defect Triage:** Throughout my roles as QA Lead and Senior Quality Engineer—including at Avant Mutual and Wpay—I have led cross-functional release management, daily defect triage sessions, and alignment meetings with developers, business leads, and external partners. I have also functioned in dual Business Analyst/QA roles to translate complex requirements into actionable release readiness criteria.

MAX’s commitment to delivering reliable technology across thousands of venues across Australia resonates with my experience ensuring the compliance, security, and functional integrity of high-volume, regulated platform releases. I am confident that my mix of automation engineering, structured test planning, and clear stakeholder communication will add immediate value to your delivery streams.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my test engineering leadership and technical capabilities can support Tabcorp and MAX. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,  

**Anoop Sinkaran**
